execution_order: CG then PCG on even repetitions; PCG then CG on odd repetitions
matrix: A = S K S, where K = kron(I,T) + kron(T,I) + 0.05 I; T is the 1D Dirichlet tridiagonal matrix with diagonal 2 and off-diagonal -1; S=diag(s), s=0.5 + 3.5*(0.65*x + 0.35*y), with x,y coordinates on linspace(0,1,grid_side)
rhs_generation: seeded standard-normal exact solution x_star; b=A@x_star
